name: Peter Findley
method: Built-in Claude desktop browser pane, 2026-10-30. Loaded the public Kaggle About page and the Competitions page once each (about 6 seconds of render wait, 5 seconds between pages), read with page text plus a read-only look at the page's own elements (join-date tooltip, medal icon alt text, avatar image address) and screenshots of the competition list to read the medal icons. No sign-in action, no refresh loop, no rate-limit or block page appeared. The browser pane was already signed in as the Boss; nothing was clicked except scrolling. An older draft of this file written while Kaggle was blocking the desk was discarded and rebuilt only from these live pages.

profile.competitionTierNote: Searched the visible text of both the About and Competitions pages, and the Competitions page's markup, for a tier label (Novice, Contributor, Expert, Master, Grandmaster), a competition rank and a medal summary, and found none. Nothing was inferred from the colour of the ring around the avatar, so no tier is recorded.
profile.medalsBasis: Counted from the medal icons beside each completed competition in the list (one bronze icon on NVIDIA Nemotron Model Reasoning Challenge, none on the other five). Kaggle's own profile medal total was not displayed.
profile.pinnedWork: AI Mathematical Olympiad - Progress Prize 3 (1583rd of 4,138)

portrait.note: Confirmed on 2026-10-30. The saved 320 by 320 picture is the same image as the current profile picture on his Kaggle page (a grey British shorthair cat in a deerstalker hat with a pipe), compared by eye against the full 400 by 400 original at https://storage.googleapis.com/kaggle-avatars/images/15427939-kg.png?t=2026-02-18-16-16-06. It is his own individual profile picture: not a group image and not Kaggle's default grey avatar. It is the avatar he chose, not a photograph of his face, and no photograph of him was found in the sources checked (the two Kaggle pages). Status follows the desk's convention in the sibling evidence files, where a player's own chosen avatar (duck, fox, cat, rabbit, robot, anime character) is recorded as own-verified, and only Kaggle's default grey placeholder is recorded as none-available. No replacement was needed and the saved file was not touched.
